title: 028. Binary Search
javaSig: public int search(int[] nums, int target)
prompt: Given sorted array `nums` and `target`, return its index in `O(log N)` time, or `-1` if absent.
invariant: Target (if present) stays inside closed interval [l, r]
firstLine: Set `l, r = 0, len(nums) - 1` and loop `while l <= r:`.
steps: If `nums[mid] < target`, set `l = mid + 1`; else `r = mid - 1`; return `-1` if not found
pythonOutlineComments:
# Step 1: Initialize `l = 0`, `r = len(nums) - 1`
# Step 2: Compute `mid = (l + r) // 2`; if `nums[mid] == target`, return `mid`
# Step 3: If `nums[mid] < target`, set `l = mid + 1`; else `r = mid - 1`; return `-1` if not found
